title: Reduce console chat worker Docker image size by making ML deps optional

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
The console chat worker Lambda (`dashboard/amplify/functions/consoleRunWorker/Dockerfile`) was downloading torch (~532MB), nvidia_cudnn (~366MB), and other heavy ML packages it never uses. Root cause is two-layered:

1. **Plexus itself** — 27 heavy ML packages (sklearn, xgboost, transformers, bertopic, etc.) were required core deps; they are now being moved to a `[ml]`, `[infra]`, and `[all]` optional extras.
2. **Tactus transitive dep** — `tactus` requires `biblicus[reinforcement-memory]` as a hard core dep, which chains to `bertopic → sentence-transformers → torch`. Tactus is being patched (tcts-6722aa) to make this optional via `tactus[rca]`.

**Definition of Done:**
- `pip install plexus` (bare) installs no torch/sklearn/xgboost/transformers
- `pip install plexus[all]` restores full behaviour for score processor and local dev
- Console worker Docker build no longer downloads torch or NVIDIA packages
- Score processor Docker build uses `plexus[all]` and remains fully functional
- CI passes

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Investigating recurring Amplify main-branch failures. CloudFormation shows no events during failed window, indicating failures occur during CDK asset build/publish before stack update. Latest retry (job 1129) fails with Failed to build asset ConsoleChatResponder/ConsoleChatResponderFunction/AssetImage. Planning a code fix to stop building this image inside Amplify pipeline.
